response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_diff FROM budget WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS baseline FROM s) SELECT s.event_status, s.avg_diff AS average_amount_minus_spent, s.avg_diff - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM s CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a NULL amount or spent are dropped before grouping. Statuses with no valid difference therefore don't appear and don't count toward the baseline. Each remaining status counts once in the baseline, whatever its row count.
A NULL event_status, if any exists, would form its own group and be counted in the baseline. The data has no such rows, as far as the schema shows.
